title: Paw patrol folding table and chairs
text:
Paw patrol folding table and chairs. Wow. I wasn't expecting much from this set... It's pretty heavy. And sturdy. The top is a cushioned plastic with the paw patrol gang on it... the folding chairs have the paw patrol emblem on the backs... plain blue seats. Honestly, these are quite a bit more study that I had expected. I bought because I could easily fold and store when my grandsons, 2 1/2 and 5 are not visiting. I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful, nor do I shy away from answering comments/questions. I do NOT receive compensation of ANY kind for my reviews. My purchases are VERIFIED, FULL price and 100% independent. As are my reviews! They are fully my opinion, which could differ from yours - and that's ok. Happy shopping!
UPDATE: 11/15/2016.... I have been regularly using this set... up, down, up down.... I still believe it is a super sturdy set. Honestly, I really didn't expect it to be so sturdy. It's been heavily used and loved. It wipes up easily with the vinyl type material... I can still highly recommend this purchase if you are considering it. * will continue to update if any new info would be useful.
UPDATE: 2/17/2017... Still regularly using and very happy with the quality and sturdiness of this set. I would buy it again, but as sturdy as it is I probably won't need to. My grandsons will outgrow it before it gives out.
